lifecycle.description: Canonical task lifecycle. offered is the root. Surplus tasks are terminally rejected outside any RSU queue with no retry. Admitted tasks proceed through placement/execution/return; forwarded is a path event recording ingress->execution RSU difference, not a separate accounting class.

waiting_room_ceiling.definition: Per-RSU admission/in-flight ceiling (waiting-room limit) counting waiting + served tasks. Not compute service rate, not worker capacity, not multiplied compute power.
waiting_room_ceiling.per_vehicle_arithmetic: rsu_max_concurrent = round(capacity_per_vehicle * N); capacity_per_vehicle is dimensionless scalar, N is padded vehicle-slot count (maxN). Report both per-vehicle scalar and absolute per-RSU count with N to avoid per-vehicle wording without arithmetic.

lifecycle.zero_latency_rejected_fiction_prohibited: Rejected tasks never enter queue, never acquire latency measurement. They must not be placed in a completed bucket with latency 0.

physical_distinctions.compute_completed: RSU finished execution of admitted task (physical compute).
physical_distinctions.returned: Result successfully returned to vehicle/consumer over network path.
physical_distinctions.deadline_success: Returned result met application deadline (deadline attainment). Flag alone is not proof of physical return without return evidence.
physical_distinctions.dropped: Computed result failed to return (loss) or was discarded after compute.
physical_distinctions.conflation_prohibited: returned must be strictly distinguished from compute_completed; equality implies dropped==0 and must be explicitly justified, not silently conflated.

placement_admission_scaling_separation.placement: Selecting execution RSU (deterministic JSQ/P2C/deadline-aware or learned); operates on admitted tasks and may cause forwarding.
placement_admission_scaling_separation.admission: Gate decision admitting offered task to RSU queue subject to waiting-room ceiling; terminal rejection is admission outcome.
placement_admission_scaling_separation.scaling: Adjusting compute service rate/workers (fixed 1x, static 3x, reactive Kubernetes-style); does not change admission ceiling in this model.
placement_admission_scaling_separation.rule: A change to waiting-room ceiling must not be described as compute-capacity or scaling change.

denominators.headline_rule: Report deadline attainment over offered as headline. Admitted completion is conditional diagnostic only.
denominators.energy_denominators: Report energy both per offered task and per admitted task where applicable.

instrumentation_honesty.unknown_field_rule: Any lifecycle field not natively emitted by the evaluator must be explicit null with reason in unavailable_instrumentation; do not manufacture a value.
unavailable_instrumentation_for_e2d: started is not separately instrumented in vec_env evaluator; treated as == admitted in this reconciliation with explicit note

compute_completed vs returned distinction is not natively instrumented: vec_env reports deadline_success as deadline attainment, not confirmed physical return; raw per-task return path is bounded unavailable
forwarding energy/cost and stale-state telemetry age are not natively emitted
forbidden_fabrications: Do not infer physical completion from deadline flag alone
Do not assign zero latency to rejected tasks
Do not set returned == compute_completed without dropped accounting and explicit justification
Do not use per-vehicle wording for per-RSU ceiling without arithmetic (capacity * N = absolute)
